name: Hilton Honors American Express Surpass® Card

loungeAccess.network: Priority Pass Select (1,300+ airport lounges worldwide)
loungeAccess.notes: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership (enrollment required). Complimentary access for cardholder; guests charged standard Priority Pass fee (~$32/person). Note: As of early 2023, Amex removed complimentary Priority Pass from the Surpass — verify current terms as benefits can change.

tripDelay.notes: Up to $500 per covered trip. Delay must be 6+ hours or require overnight stay. Maximum 2 claims per 12-month period.

tripCancellation.notes: Maximum $10,000 per covered trip, $20,000 per eligible card account per 12 consecutive months.

lostBaggage.notes: High-risk items (jewelry, electronics) capped at $1,000 per person per trip.

emergencyMedical.notes: Global Assist Hotline: 24/7 assistance coordination including medical evacuation referrals. Actual transport costs are cardholder's responsibility.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide except Australia, Italy, New Zealand, and OFAC-sanctioned countries.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary car rental coverage — file with personal auto insurance first. Up to 30 consecutive days.

otherCredits.name: Hilton Free Night Reward
otherCredits.notes: One complimentary weekend night reward after spending $15,000 on the card in a calendar year. Redeemable at most Hilton portfolio properties (some exclusions apply).

otherCredits.name: Hilton Honors Bonus Points Package
otherCredits.notes: Spend $40,000 in a calendar year to earn an additional free weekend night reward.

rewards.travelRate: 12x at hotels and resorts in the Hilton portfolio

pointValue.transferPartners: 0.4–0.6¢ per Hilton Honors point; best redeemed for Hilton hotel stays

travelPerks: Complimentary Hilton Honors Gold status (no spending requirement)
Priority Pass Select airport lounge access
12x Hilton Honors points on Hilton hotel stays
6x points at US restaurants, supermarkets, and gas stations
Free weekend night reward after $15,000 annual spend
Secondary rental car insurance up to $75,000
Global Assist Hotline for emergency coordination
bestFor: Hilton loyalists who want complimentary Gold status, Priority Pass lounge access, and strong hotel earning rates for a mid-tier annual fee
